client.profile: fresh temporary headless profile with the normal Chrome 150 user agent

capture.format: Chrome NetLog IncludeSensitive, then reduced by sanitize_netlog.mjs
covered_sessions: priming page load plus RFC 8441 extended CONNECT
one MiB in each WebSocket direction
WebSocket PING PONG and graceful CLOSE
HTTP/2 stream flow-control stall and WINDOW_UPDATE recovery

notes: The raw NetLog contains local certificate and machine details and is intentionally not committed.
Chrome originates the captured H2 PING immediately before its active WebSocket CLOSE; Node acknowledges it. This is not an idle periodic keepalive.
Chrome used BoringSSL. YUME dev2 still uses OpenSSL and therefore does not claim byte-identical Chrome TLS or matching JA4.
No random padding or timing jitter was observed in this local bulk fixture; dev2 must not invent either.
